_comment: Copy needed entries to .mcp.json (project-shared) or add via `claude mcp add --scope user`. Never enable external MCP servers on restricted-data repositories without checking your DUA. stata-mcp and context7 are pinned (checked 2026-11-06); bump them deliberately. r-mcptools runs whatever mcptools version your R library holds; pin it there (e.g. renv).
